_what_this_file_is: A record that one pre-registered batch-3 cell was NOT run before the submission deadline, written
and committed BEFORE the decision took effect, so the reasoning travels with the artifact instead
of living in a chat transcript. Same convention as scripts/run_power_topup_small.sh, which wrote
its concurrency waiver into its own log rather than relying on a conversation.
This file does not amend results/v57_prospective3/preregistration_v3.json. The registration stands
as committed, at 10 cells. This file says which of them has no outcome and why.
decided_by: author decision, recorded by the assistant that proposed it

_note: condition_A is the zero-shot arm. It is an INPUT to the gate score, not an outcome: the gate is
computed from zero-shot validation MSE and the fitted ridge baseline, and run_prospective3.sh
(lines 56-66) requires >= 2 condition_A records for this cell before it will start any B/D run.
The quantity the arm predicts is the B-vs-D contrast, and ZERO records of it exist. So no outcome
for this cell was observable when the decision was taken.

detail: The paper is being submitted to ICLR 2027 main track with a 36-hour window (deadline 2026-09-26
10:34 local). Measured cost of this cell is ~16.5 h of Moirai-Large fine-tuning on the serial
MPS critical path (band 13-20 h), against ~26 h of total experiment window that also has to
carry the base_Electricity7_h192 tail (6.3 h), a seed repair on large_ETTm2_h192 (4.45 h) and
the pre-registered power top-up (11.3 h). 38.5 h of runs did not fit in 26 h.
The 16.5 h was spent instead on completing a gate-PASSING cell to its full 3 seeds and on
finishing the pre-registered power top-up, both of which were also incomplete.

why_this_is_not_outcome_dependent_select: No outcome for this cell existed at the moment of the decision (see records_present_at_decision):
0 condition_B and 0 condition_D records. The choice therefore cannot have been informed by, and
cannot have been made to avoid, this cell's result.
The cell is gate-FAILING (gate_val -0.278 < 0.20 threshold, predict_gate_rule false). Batch 3
registered 8 gate-failing cells; 7 remain. Gate-failing cells are what makes SPECIFICITY
estimable, which is the stated deliverable of this arm, so removing one can only WEAKEN the
arm's main estimate. It cannot manufacture a favourable result: a gate-failing cell that did not
degrade would have been evidence FOR the screen, and that is the evidence being given up.
Sensitivity remains unestimable at zero prevalence either way, as the registration already states.
reported_as: The paper reports batch 3 as 9 of 10 registered cells, names large_ETTm2_h96 as pending, and
states both facts above in the body. The registration file is unchanged and still lists 10 cells,
so the shortfall is visible by diffing the registration against the scored cells.
if_it_completes_after_all: A bounded attempt may be made as a concurrent third leg if free memory allows, abandoned the
moment it threatens the critical path. If all 6 B/D records land before the data freeze, this
file is DELETED rather than published, and the arm is reported at 10 of 10. The presence of this
file in a released artifact therefore means the cell did not complete.
